quests.instruction: You squeeze blue and yellow paint onto a plate and stir. What color appears?
quests.hint: Imagine leaves in spring, a mix of the sky and the sun.
quests.explanation: Blue and yellow mix to make green.
quests.funFact: Many painters mix their own greens instead of buying them.

quests.instruction: Which two paints could you mix to make orange?
quests.hint: Orange sits between two warm colors.
quests.explanation: Red and yellow together make orange, the color between them in a rainbow.
quests.funFact: If you add more yellow, the orange gets lighter and sunnier.

quests.instruction: Red, yellow and blue are called primary colors. Which one of these is a primary color?
quests.hint: The other two are made by mixing.
quests.explanation: Yellow is a primary color, because you cannot make it by mixing other paints.
quests.funFact: Primary colors are the starting point for mixing paints.

quests.instruction: A girl mixes red and blue paint. What color does she get?
quests.hint: It is the color of grapes.
quests.explanation: Red and blue mix to make purple.
quests.funFact: Purple has been a color of kings and queens for a long time.

quests.instruction: Which of these is NOT a primary color?
quests.hint: One of them can be made by mixing two others.
quests.explanation: Green is made from blue and yellow, so it is a secondary color.
quests.funFact: Secondary colors come from mixing two primary colors.

quests.instruction: Your paint is too dark. You want a lighter blue. What do you add?
quests.hint: Think of clouds and snow.
quests.explanation: White makes a color lighter, like sky blue.
quests.funFact: Adding a tiny bit of white goes a long way.

quests.instruction: A child only has a blue crayon and a yellow crayon, but wants to color grass. What can she do?
quests.correctAnswer: Color yellow, then blue on top
options: Color yellow, then blue on top
quests.hint: Crayons can be layered.
quests.explanation: Yellow with blue on top looks green.
quests.funFact: Crayons and colored pencils can be layered to make new colors.

quests.instruction: You mix a little black into yellow. The color is now...
quests.hint: Think about adding something dark.
quests.explanation: Adding black makes a color darker.
quests.funFact: Yellow with a drop of black can look olive green.

quests.instruction: Orange and green are secondary colors. Which of these is also a secondary color?
quests.hint: Secondary colors are made by mixing two others.
quests.explanation: Purple is made from red and blue, so it is a secondary color.
quests.funFact: The three secondary colors are orange, green and purple.

quests.instruction: You mix red and yellow, then add a lot of red. What color do you get?
quests.hint: Imagine the color of a sunset.
quests.explanation: More red makes the orange look redder.
quests.funFact: Mixing amounts gives many new colors.

quests.instruction: Mint is green with white added. What kind of green is mint?
quests.hint: Think about adding something pale.
quests.explanation: Mint is a pale, fresh green.
quests.funFact: Adding white to a color makes a tint.

quests.instruction: Black and white paint are mixed in equal amounts. What color do you get?
quests.hint: Remember a pencil mark.
quests.explanation: Black and white mix to make gray.
quests.funFact: A drop of black in white gives a very light gray.

quests.instruction: Which group has only shades of blue?
quests.hint: Check every word.
quests.explanation: Sky, navy and royal are all kinds of blue.
quests.funFact: Many colors come in light and dark shades.

quests.instruction: A paint set has red, yellow and blue. Which new color can you make using only these?
quests.hint: Pick the one made from two of them.
quests.explanation: Red and blue make purple.
quests.funFact: You can make many colors from just three paints.

quests.instruction: Which mix is wrong? "Blue and yellow make green." "Red and yellow make orange." "Red and blue make yellow."
quests.hint: One mix does not match what we know.
quests.explanation: Red and blue make purple, not yellow.
quests.funFact: Yellow is a primary color, so you cannot mix it.

quests.instruction: Sort these blues from lightest to darkest: sky blue, royal blue, navy. Which is in the middle?
quests.hint: It may remind you of the order from light to dark.
quests.explanation: Royal blue is darker than sky blue but lighter than navy.
quests.funFact: Navy is nearly as dark as night.

quests.instruction: A boy mixes all of his paints together on one plate. What color is it likely to be?
quests.hint: Many colors together look dull.
quests.explanation: Mixing many colors together often turns them into brown or dark gray.
quests.funFact: Painters keep brushes clean so colors stay bright.

quests.instruction: A child painted a lion's fur pink by mistake. Which color should the fur be?
quests.hint: Think of dry grass.
quests.explanation: A lion's fur is tan, so pink is the mistake.
quests.funFact: Spotting color mistakes helps you learn what things look like.

quests.instruction: A set of dishes has a blue bowl, a blue cup and one more piece. Which piece completes the matching set?
quests.hint: The set is all one color.
quests.explanation: A blue plate completes the blue set.
quests.funFact: A matching set uses the same color.

quests.instruction: Which word is a shade of green?
quests.hint: Think of a small green fruit on a pizza.
quests.explanation: Olive is a dull, yellowish green.
quests.funFact: Olive trees can live for hundreds of years.

quests.instruction: You want brown. Which two paints could you mix?
quests.hint: Imagine two colors across from each other.
quests.explanation: Red and green together make a brown color.
quests.funFact: Many browns are made by mixing colors that are far apart.

quests.instruction: Sort these into red things: tomato, cherry, lime, strawberry. Which does NOT belong in the red group?
quests.hint: Pick the one that is green.
quests.explanation: A lime is green, so it does not belong with red things.
quests.funFact: Sorting by color helps us see patterns.

quests.instruction: Which group of colors are all secondary colors?
quests.hint: They are made from mixing.
quests.explanation: Orange, green and purple are secondary colors.
quests.funFact: Each secondary color is made from two primary colors.

quests.instruction: Which group has only yellow things?
quests.hint: Check every item in each group.
quests.explanation: The group with lemon, sunflower and duck is all yellow.
quests.funFact: Checking each item takes care and patience.

quests.instruction: You mix purple and white. What color do you get?
quests.hint: White lightens a color.
quests.explanation: Purple and white make a soft light purple called lilac.
quests.funFact: Pale purples are often seen in spring flowers.

quests.instruction: Which color is darker: red with black added, or red with white added?
quests.hint: Black deepens a color.
quests.explanation: Adding black makes red darker, like a deep cherry color.
quests.funFact: Adding white makes pink.

quests.instruction: A mix of blue and orange can make a dull color. What color might it be?
quests.hint: Colors that are far apart can look dull.
quests.explanation: Orange and blue are far apart on the color wheel, so they make a dull brownish color.
quests.funFact: Artists use this to make shadows.

quests.instruction: A crayon box is sorted from lightest to darkest. White is first and black is last. Which crayon is probably in the middle?
quests.hint: Think of a mix of black and white.
quests.explanation: Gray sits between white and black.
quests.funFact: Gray is called a neutral color.

quests.instruction: Two paint cans are labeled "ocean blue" and "sky blue." Which one is darker?
quests.hint: Ocean water looks deeper.
quests.explanation: Ocean blue is a deeper, darker blue than sky blue.
quests.funFact: Deep water looks darker because less light reaches it.

quests.instruction: Which pair shows a light color and a dark color of the same kind?
quests.hint: Look for the same color in two shades.
quests.explanation: Light green and dark green are both green, one pale and one deep.
quests.funFact: Shades of one color look good together.
